name: benchmark-diversity-data
description: A dataset intended to support analysis of dataset diversity and representation across benchmarks (e.g., demographic, geographic, or topical diversity). It provides data and/or metadata that enable calculation of diversity statistics and comparison between datasets. Typical uses include measuring coverage, detecting skew, and informing dataset curation or debiasing efforts.
evaluation_method: descriptive_statistics / diversity_metrics (e.g., entropy, representation rates, Simpson index)
reputation: Small, specialist dataset useful for dataset auditing and diversity analyses; limited mainstream adoption.
